global_identity.color_palette: the colors of the product's packaging
global_identity.text_typography: the typography of the reference ad

visual_prompt:
Product: VITALDROPS, for 18 a 55 (market: Colombia).
Secondary texts: short and about the main benefit of the product.
Angle: the SAME one as the reference ad (same body area, problem or desire, same hook). Only if the reference has no clear angle, use: Dolor / problema.
Adapt the color palette to the product's packaging, keeping the same contrast and hierarchy as the reference.
The reference is a TEMPLATE from another brand: keep its structure, composition, visual hierarchy, typography and the kind of image (person, body area, illustration or diagram), but nothing of its brand. If it shows a price, a discount, a quantity offer or an offer badge, put there a short benefit or call to action instead (no prices, no percentages, no "2 x"). Before and after, days and timelines only as the reference shows them, for this product.
All visible text in Spanish, perfectly spelled, with accents. The product must look exactly like the attached product photo.

text_layers.reference_position: same place as the main headline of the reference
text_layers.text: —Tenemos que hablar. —¿De qué? —De por qué ya no me miras igual. (Diálogo actuado)
text_layers.text_style: same style as the main headline of the reference

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo
final_generation_exclusions: any logo, brand name or text from the reference ad

forbidden_additions: the reference ad's brand, prices or claims
